configurationFields.label: Starting Map
configurationFields.description: Set the server's starting map. Not all scenarios work with all maps.

configurationFields.label: Starting Scenario
configurationFields.description: Set the server's starting scenario. Not all scenarios work with all maps. Must be set to None/Random if no map is chosen.

configurationFields.label: Starting Lighting
configurationFields.description: Set the server's starting lighting. Must be set to Day if no map and Scenario are chosen.

configurationFields.label: Starting Game Mode
configurationFields.description: Set the server's starting game mode. Must be set to None/Random if no map and Scenario are chosen.

configurationFields.label: Hostname
configurationFields.description: Set the servers hostname

configurationFields.label: Spielerlimit
configurationFields.description: Set server maximum amount of players

configurationFields.label: Token
configurationFields.description: Set the steam GSLTToken APPID 581320 [Get A GSLToken ID](https://steamcommunity.com/dev/managegameservers/)

configurationFields.label: Game Stats Token
configurationFields.description: Set the game stats token for XP Gain [Get A GameStats Token ID](https://gamestats.sandstorm.game/)

configurationFields.label: Password
configurationFields.description: Sets a password for the server

configurationFields.label: RCON-Passwort
configurationFields.description: See the Security and Privacy menu for configurable options for the server's RCON

configurationFields.label: Mutator
configurationFields.description: Set server mutators (comma separated)

configurationFields.label: Rule Set
configurationFields.description: Set the rules for the server

configurationFields.label: Mods Enabled
configurationFields.description: Enables the server to use a Modlist

configurationFields.label: Mod Travel To
configurationFields.description: Set the Mod Travel to

configurationFields.label: MOTD
configurationFields.description: Set the server MOTD

configurationFields.label: Admin Players
configurationFields.description: A list of Steam64 IDs for players that are in-game admins. [Find your Steam64 ID](https://steamid.io/)

configurationFields.label: Cheats Enabled
configurationFields.description: Enables cheat commands on the server

configurationFields.label: Map Cycle
configurationFields.description: A List of map scenarios for the server to use

configurationFields.label: Mods
configurationFields.description: Define a list of Mods for the server to use.

configurationFields.label: Kill Feed Enabled
configurationFields.description: Is the kill feed enabled?

configurationFields.label: Kill Feed Spectator
configurationFields.description: Is the kill feed enabled for dedicated spectators and replays?

configurationFields.label: Display Killer Info
configurationFields.description: Show information about a death (killer, weapon) to the victim?

configurationFields.label: Kill Distance Reveal
configurationFields.description: Reveal distance of kills?

configurationFields.label: Team Kill Limit
configurationFields.description: Limit for the number of team kills one player can perform before being kicked.

configurationFields.label: Team Kill Grace Timer
configurationFields.description: Grace timer between team killing incidents.

configurationFields.label: Team Kill Reduce Time
configurationFields.description: How long until a player’s TK count reduces by 1.

configurationFields.label: Can the dead speak?
configurationFields.description: Can alive players see messages from the dead?

configurationFields.label: Can the dead speak to teammates?
configurationFields.description: Can alive players see messages from dead teammates using team-only chat?

configurationFields.label: Allow Dead Players Voice Chat?
configurationFields.description: Can alive players hear voice chat from dead players?

configurationFields.label: Allow enemies to hear proximity chat?
configurationFields.description: Can proximity voice chat be heard by enemies?

configurationFields.label: Allow radio chat to broadcast on local channel
configurationFields.description: Can radio chat also broadcast on the local channel?

configurationFields.label: Objective Capture Time
configurationFields.description: How long it takes to capture territorial objectives.

configurationFields.label: Objective Reset Time
configurationFields.description: How long objective progress decays with no one on the point. Negative value disables.

configurationFields.label: Objective Speed Up Time
configurationFields.description: Additional capture speed-up for each player on the point.

configurationFields.label: Objective Speed Up Players
configurationFields.description: Maximum players taken into account for capture speed-up.

configurationFields.label: Kill Feed Game Starting Intermission time
configurationFields.description: How long after a round starts before showing a kill feed

configurationFields.label: Game Start Intermission Timer
configurationFields.description: The additional time to wait for additional players during the starting intermission.

configurationFields.label: Win Time
configurationFields.description: How long players are frozen before transitioning to the round intermission screen.

configurationFields.label: Time Spent on Intermision Screen.
configurationFields.description: How long is spent on the intermission screen.

configurationFields.label: Time Spent inbetween rounds
configurationFields.description: How much time is spent between last post round and game over.

configurationFields.label: Auto Assign Teams?
configurationFields.description: Should teams be assigned on connect?

configurationFields.label: Allow Friendly Fire?
configurationFields.description: Enables friendly fire.

configurationFields.label: Friendly Fire Damage Modifier
configurationFields.description: Damage modifier for friendly fire

configurationFields.label: Friendly Fire Reflect Damage
configurationFields.description: Damage modifier for friendly fire that is mirrored back at the attacker.

configurationFields.label: Auto Balance Teams
configurationFields.description: Enables auto team balancing.

configurationFields.label: Auto Balance Delay
configurationFields.description: How long to wait after detecting unbalanced teams.

configurationFields.label: Map Voting
configurationFields.description: Enabled map voting at the end of each game.

configurationFields.label: Enable Map Cycle
configurationFields.description: Enables the use of the map cycle. If disabled, the current map loops indefinitely.

configurationFields.label: Allow Voice During Intermission?
configurationFields.description: Allow both teams to talk to each other between rounds.

configurationFields.label: Idle Kick Timer
configurationFields.description: How long a player can be idle for before being kicked.

configurationFields.label: Low Reinforcements Idle Timer
configurationFields.description: How long a player can idle for when there are low reinforcements.

configurationFields.label: Check For Idle Players Timer
configurationFields.description: How frequently to check for idle players.

configurationFields.label: Allow 3rd Person Spectate?
configurationFields.description: Can Players use 3rd person spectator mode?

configurationFields.label: Minimum Players to start the game.
configurationFields.description: Minimum players required on each team to start the game.

configurationFields.label: Round Limit
configurationFields.description: Maximum number of rounds to play.

configurationFields.label: Win Limit
configurationFields.description: Number of rounds required for game victory.

configurationFields.label: Game Time Limit
configurationFields.description: Number of rounds required for game victory.

configurationFields.label: Pre Round Limit
configurationFields.description: Amount of “freeze time” at the start of a round.

configurationFields.label: Round Time
configurationFields.description: Duration of the round.

configurationFields.label: Overtime
configurationFields.description: Amount of overtime given when there is an objective being contested after the round timer expires.

configurationFields.label: Team Switch Time
configurationFields.description: Minimum additional time spent between team switches.

configurationFields.label: Switch Team Every Round
configurationFields.description: How often to switch teams. 0 = never, 1 = every round, 2 = every other round, etc.

configurationFields.label: Allow Players to Switch Teams
configurationFields.description: Allow players to switch to the other team?

configurationFields.label: Enable Bots?
configurationFields.description: Enables Bots

configurationFields.label: Bot Quota Fill
configurationFields.description: Bot quota to fill.

configurationFields.label: Initial Supply Points
configurationFields.description: Amount of starting supply points.

configurationFields.label: Maximum Supply Points
configurationFields.description: Maximum supply that can be earned.

configurationFields.label: Enable Supply Gain
configurationFields.description: Enable supply gain throughout the round.

configurationFields.label: Instant Supply Gain
configurationFields.description: Should supply gain be awarded instantly?

configurationFields.label: Supply Gain Frequency
configurationFields.description: Score threshold for earning supply.
